note: Bundled fallback copy of the 30 draft lessons. Mirrors speech_lessons seeds in supabase/schema.sql. All status values are draft until grown-ups approve them.

lessons.title: Warm-up: lips, breath, humming
lessons.mouth_text: Lips closed, hum. Feel the buzz.

lessons.title: S alone
lessons.mouth_text: Teeth close, tongue low. Blow: sssss, like a snake.

lessons.title: S words
lessons.mouth_text: Same S as a snake. Keep it long and quiet.

lessons.title: S at the end
lessons.mouth_text: End the word with a soft snake sound.

lessons.title: S blends
lessons.mouth_text: Start with S, then stop the air quickly.

lessons.title: S or SH
lessons.mouth_text: S: teeth close. SH: lips a little round.

lessons.title: S or TH
lessons.mouth_text: TH: tongue tip between your teeth.

lessons.title: TH sound
lessons.mouth_text: Tongue tip between your teeth. Blow gently.

lessons.title: Z sound
lessons.mouth_text: Same place as S, but let your voice buzz.

lessons.title: R or L
lessons.mouth_text: R: tongue curls back, no touch. L: tongue tip touches the roof.

lessons.title: V or F
lessons.mouth_text: Top teeth on bottom lip. F: no voice. V: buzz.

lessons.title: Short vowels
lessons.mouth_text: A: mouth wide. E: mouth a little smaller.

lessons.title: Ship or sheep
lessons.mouth_text: Ship: short and relaxed. Sheep: smile and hold.

lessons.title: Ends of words
lessons.mouth_text: Stop the sound at the end. Don't add a vowel.

lessons.title: Silly sentences
lessons.mouth_text: Say it slowly, then a bit faster.

lessons.title: Warm-up: mouth and breath
lessons.mouth_text: Open wide and say ah, oh, um.

lessons.title: Easy starts
lessons.mouth_text: Lips together, then open. Puff for p.

lessons.title: S sound
lessons.mouth_text: Teeth close, tongue low. Blow: sssss.

lessons.title: SH sound
lessons.mouth_text: Tongue curls up behind the top. Blow softly.

lessons.title: S or SH
lessons.mouth_text: S: tongue flat. SH: tongue curled up.

lessons.title: Z, C, S
lessons.mouth_text: Z: short. C: puff. S: long hiss.

lessons.title: ZH, CH, R
lessons.mouth_text: Tongue tip curled back. R buzzes a little.

lessons.title: J, Q, X
lessons.mouth_text: Tongue flat, tip down. X is a soft hiss.

lessons.title: S or X
lessons.mouth_text: S: tongue tip behind bottom teeth. X: tongue flat.

lessons.title: Ü sound
lessons.mouth_text: Say ee, then round your lips.

lessons.title: N or NG
lessons.mouth_text: N: tongue touches top. NG: back of tongue up.

lessons.title: Tones 1 and 2
lessons.mouth_text: Tone 1 stays high. Tone 2 climbs up.

lessons.title: Tones 3 and 4
lessons.mouth_text: Tone 3 dips down then up. Tone 4 drops fast.

lessons.title: Neutral tone
lessons.mouth_text: Soft and short, no tone mark.

lessons.title: Silly sentence
lessons.mouth_text: Say it slowly with a clear S.
